hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Inversion with Volatility-Adjusted Delta
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Overcomes self-correlation constraints by operating strictly within the supply chain relationship domain. Dynamically branches between 10-day linearly decayed customer return reversal (>0.6 threshold) and volatility-adjusted 3-day price reversal. Normalizing price delta by rolling 20-day standard deviation eliminates beta distortions, driving Sharpe > 1.30 and Fitness > 1.00 with Self-Correlation < 0.40.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volatility adjustment inflates turnover or degrades sub-universe Sharpe below 0.50.

candidates.rationale: Customer return inversion (>0.6) with volatility-adjusted 3-day reversal

hypotheses.title: Analyst SUE Reversal with Volatility-Adjusted Delta
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines quarterly analyst consensus earnings surprise reversal (inherently ultra-low 3% turnover) with volatility-adjusted 3-day short-term mean reversion. This creates a multi-frequency alpha combining quarterly fundamental expectations exhaustion with weekly liquidity reversal, completely orthogonal to options VRP (Self-Correlation < 0.30).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if analyst surprise signal does not provide cross-sectional return dispersion.

candidates.rationale: Analyst surprise reversal (>0.5) with volatility-adjusted 3-day reversal
